captions.detailed: This 3D-printable object is a dual-sided utility clip designed to mount onto a board and hold a cylindrical pen or marker. One side features a rectangular U-shaped channel that slides over the edge of a flat board, while the other side features a semi-circular, flexible C-clip designed to snap around a marker. The entire clip is extruded to a uniform width, creating a compact and durable single-piece design.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric marker board clip in OpenSCAD. The design should feature a rectangular U-clip on one side to fit a specified board thickness, and a cylindrical C-clip on the opposite side to hold a marker of a given radius, with customizable clip width and wall thickness parameters.
captions.factory: The model is constructed using two main parts joined together and rotated. The board clip is created with a difference() operation subtracting a smaller cube from a larger cube to form a U-channel. The marker clip is created with a rotated difference() operation where a smaller cylinder is subtracted from a larger cylinder, and a third cylinder is subtracted offset from the center to create the opening of the C-clip. Key parameters include BOARD_THICKNESS, MARKER_RADIUS, CLIP_THICKNESS, and CLIP_WIDTH.
